Create a 20-second high-end live-action dark-fantasy combat sequence in the Anger realm from the user’s Voices in the Void: Hollow Heart project. This is a dedicated specialist fight for the giant Hand-Crown Centipede Stalker. The scene must feel epic as fuck, brutal, eventful, physically grounded, and visually unforgettable. It must feel like the Hero is trying to survive a horrifying large-scale predator while still forcing his way deeper through the Anger realm.

This should be one relentless cinematic survival sequence: the Hero runs, gets pursued, gets hit, gets knocked down, adapts, uses the environment intelligently, injures the creature, and breaks past it. He is not effortlessly stronger than it. He survives because he refuses to stop and thinks under pressure.

REFERENCE / DESIGN RULE:
Use the provided Hand-Crown Centipede reference strictly as a DESIGN / ANATOMY / SILHOUETTE blueprint, not as a style reference. Preserve the recognizable identity: the giant grotesque hand-headed centipede body, weaponized finger-crown, eye and mouth in the hand-head region, long many-limbed body, fused human-remnant grotesquery, and disturbing scale. Do not genericize it into a normal insect. Do not simplify it. Do not redesign it away from the approved concept.

Highest-end Hollywood live-action dark-fantasy realism. ARRI Alexa 65 cinematic fidelity. Ultra-detailed practical material realism. Expensive production value. Grounded body physics. Natural motion blur. Rich atmospheric depth. Subtle film grain. Soft lens diffusion. No game-engine look. No cheap CGI. No painterly concept-art finish. No anime movement. No rubbery creature surfaces.

Use the approved Hollow Heart Hero exactly.

Minimal facial hair.

Dirty, battle-worn clothing.
No cape.
No jeans.
No belt.
One fingerless glove.
Opposite hand wrapped.
Scarred exposed arm.
He carries the approved HEAVY SWORD.

The heavy sword must feel truly heavy and require planted footwork, shoulder engagement, body torque, and two hands for all major attacks. No effortless lightweight fantasy swinging.

ABSOLUTE HOLLOW HEART LOCK:
The Hero’s chest cavity must remain exactly correct at all times: a large irregular three-dimensional front-to-back hole through the chest with true depth and parallax, torn organic fleshy rim, and clothing torn around the opening. It must never flatten, never fill in, never shrink, never move, never be covered, never become a black decal, and never disappear during action.

The Hero is NEVER passive.
He is never casually standing there.
He is never relaxed.
He is battle-ready the entire time: breathing hard, knees active, shoulders engaged, sword ready, eyes tracking threats, body coiled to react. Even when he is running, falling, or recovering from impact, he should look locked into survival. He is exhausted, injured, bloodied, furious, and determined, but he never gives up and never mentally checks out.

scorched earth,

This creature is a major escalation enemy and must feel terrifyingly large and distinct.

Approximate scale:
about 22 feet long overall,
low predatory crawl height around 4.5 feet,

The hand-head has a monstrous eye and a grotesque toothed mouth integrated into the palm region.
Five finger-crown structures rise from the hand-head and each finger is weaponized, dangerous, and physically threatening.
The finger structures should read like grotesque bladed / hooked / spiked attack limbs, not soft decorative appendages.

The rest of the creature is a long horrifying centipede-like body made of many disgusting segments.

rear its front third upward,

its bizarre anatomy,
its hand-head weapon identity,

getting intercepted,

slide through ash and corpses,

The Hero hits the ground violently.

Before he can fully recover, the creature is already advancing — it does NOT wait for him to stand back up.

the five weaponized fingers,
then enough of the long many-limbed body to understand the scale and disturbing segmented movement.

BLOOD ON CONTACT immediately.

0:09 - 0:12
The Hero scrambles up and realizes he cannot beat this thing head-on in open space.

The Hero instantly capitalizes and attacks before it fully recovers.
He closes in with real commitment and delivers savage two-handed cuts into vulnerable limb clusters / attacking finger structures / lower front body areas.
Immediate blood.

0:15 - 0:17

It should still feel dangerous even after the trap.
It may violently fling the Hero into a corpse pile, clip him with another weaponized finger, or slam the ground beside him so hard it blasts ash and debris into the air.

0:17 - 0:20

He avoids another attack line, steps inside at the right angle, and delivers one brutal decisive two-handed cut into a key junction — for example the base of one weaponized finger, part of the hand-head structure, or another vulnerable front-limb connection.
Immediate blood.
This does NOT need to fully kill the monster.
Instead, it badly injures / cripples / disrupts it long enough for the Hero to break through the line.
End with the Hero stumbling / running deeper into the Anger realm, sword bloodied, body covered in ash and blood, still battle-ready and refusing to stop, while behind him the wounded Hand-Crown Centipede tears itself free from the tree and thrashes furiously in the burning corpse field.

Use motivated expensive camera movement, not random shaky nonsense.

parallax movement,

No effortless giant-sword nonsense.
The creature must feel fast, massive, and dangerous.
Its attacks should have violent momentum and mass.

TEXTURE / MATERIAL FIDELITY:
The Anger realm must feel filthy, scorched, corpse-littered, and physically real.

Deliver a brutal, epic, trailer-worthy 20-second Anger-realm specialist fight where the approved Hollow Heart Hero is hunted by the giant Hand-Crown Centipede Stalker, gets hurt, uses the environment intelligently, wounds the creature in savage close-range exchanges, and forces his way past it without giving up. swim through open air above the hero,
hover above the water,

fly around the canoe.

large TRUE FRONT-TO-BACK missing body volume.

quiet intelligence,
melancholy,

slight unreadable sadness.

slow powerful undulation,
secondary fin movement,

translucent membranes responding to water resistance.

High rear three-quarter view with a slow descending crane.

environmental particles.

This is a massive practical dark-steel sword partially engulfed by cursed living bookbinding / fleshy material.

The underlying steel remains clearly identifiable.

The blade is heavy.

Dark forged metal edges.

Physical crossguard.

Leather-wrapped handle.

Small chain details.

Organic binding matter wraps around portions of the blade.

Across the blade are approximately 9–14 DIFFERENT trapped human-like faces.

THE FACES ARE NOT DECORATIVE RELIEFS.

THEY ARE ALIVE.

They physically exist within the material.

Their skin has:

pores,
wrinkles,
subtle moisture,
eyelashes,
creased lips,
tiny scars,
real eye surfaces,
subtle subsurface variation.

The faces merge organically into surrounding dark leather/flesh/bookbinding material.

FACIAL EMOTION — ABSOLUTE
============================================================

THE FACES DO NOT YELL.

THE FACES DO NOT ROAR.

THE FACES DO NOT SNARL.

THE FACES DO NOT LOOK AGGRESSIVE.

Their emotional vocabulary is:

quiet agony,
grief,
hopelessness,
exhaustion,
dread,
resignation,
confusion,
suppressed pain.

MOUTHS MOSTLY CLOSED.

Some may be slightly parted.

NO giant open screaming mouths.

Every face is a DIFFERENT individual.

Male and female.

Different ages.

Different bone structures.

Different noses.

Different eyes.

Different mouths.

Different degrees of fusion.

NO CLONES.

============================================================
FACIAL MOVEMENT — MAJOR PRIORITY
============================================================

THE FACES MUST VISIBLY MOVE THROUGHOUT THE MACRO SHOTS.

But movement remains subtle and HUMAN.

They are not statues.

They are not frozen prop faces.

They are not synchronized.

Each visible face performs its own independent micro-action.

Examples:

FACE A:
eyes remain closed, then eyelids tighten slightly as though enduring pain.

FACE B:
one exhausted eye slowly opens and looks sideways.

FACE C:
lower lip trembles once.

FACE D:
jaw tightens underneath the skin.

FACE E:
eyes slowly track toward camera.

FACE F:
brow contracts and then relaxes.

FACE G:
mouth parts approximately 3–5 millimeters, then remains there.

FACE H:
one black tear slowly emerges beneath the eye.

FACE I:
eyes close weakly as though giving up.

FACE J:
cheek muscle contracts slightly.

FACE K:
stares blankly with only tiny eye micro-saccades.

FACE L:
briefly looks upward toward the Enforcer holding them.

DO NOT animate all faces identically.

DO NOT have all mouths move together.

DO NOT have them perform talking motions.

Their movement should make the viewer think:

"Those people are conscious."

BLACK TEAR DETAIL
============================================================

Only 1–3 faces have black tears.

Do not cover every face.

A fresh black tear should be:

viscous,
ink-dark,
slightly reflective.

In macro:
the tear physically forms beneath an eyelid and slowly travels several millimeters down textured skin.

No supernatural glowing liquid.

SWORD PRESENTATION
============================================================

The RED Enforcer deliberately presents the sword.

At one point it extends the blade forward and then STOPS.

The enemy's arm becomes steady.

Only natural tiny weight tremor remains.

This gives the CAMERA freedom to move around the sword while the weapon itself stays readable.

The enemy should NOT repeatedly wave the blade around.

0:00–0:02.3 — WEAPON ENTERS / STOPS
============================================================

Start at approximately chest height.

50mm lens.

RED Enforcer partially visible in dark Library bokeh.

It slowly raises the cursed sword.

The sword approaches camera diagonally.

Heavy physical inertia.

Chain details lag slightly.

Then:

THE ENFORCER EXTENDS THE WEAPON FORWARD AND STOPS.

Blade points diagonally toward / slightly past camera.

The sword becomes almost stationary.

Rack focus:

enemy book-head →
sword faces.

============================================================
0:02.3–0:05.2 — FIRST LONG MACRO TRAVEL
============================================================

100–120mm macro.

Camera begins near the sword TIP and slowly travels backward along one side of blade.

SWORD REMAINS STILL.

This shot should last long enough to STUDY the faces.

Reveal different embedded individuals sequentially.

One face has closed eyes.

One watches camera.

One lower lip trembles.

One face tightens its brow.

Very subtle living movement.

Shallow depth of field travels with camera.

Background Cursed Library becomes beautiful dark celadon bokeh.

============================================================
0:05.2–0:07.3 — SIDE PROFILE OF FACES
============================================================

A chain link / crossguard passes close to lens.

Use as physical transition.

85–100mm macro from almost perpendicular SIDE ANGLE.

Camera slides laterally along blade.

This angle proves that the faces are THREE-DIMENSIONAL and physically emerge from the material rather than being printed on it.

Show:

nose projection,
cheeks,
eyelids,
lips,
flesh disappearing beneath binding tissue.

One pair of eyes slowly opens.

Another face's jaw subtly flexes.

One black tear begins to form.

============================================================
0:07.3–0:09.3 — ULTRA-MACRO INDIVIDUAL FACE
============================================================

105–135mm extreme macro.

Fill much of frame with ONE trapped face.

Older male or female.

Expression:
utter exhausted agony.

NO SCREAMING.

Eye contains realistic moisture.

Tiny micro-saccade.

Brow tightens.

Black tear slowly travels 2–4 millimeters.

Visible:

pores,
fine wrinkles,
eyelashes,
tiny scars,
damp skin,
leather boundary surrounding cheek.

Extremely photoreal.

============================================================
0:09.3–0:11.2 — UNDER-BLADE ANGLE
============================================================

Use sword material passing close to lens as organic wipe.

Camera now positioned slightly BELOW the blade looking upward.

50–65mm.

Sword fills foreground diagonally.

RED Enforcer towers heavily bokeh behind.

Faces appear at dramatic raking angle.

Different trapped person slowly moves eyes toward enemy behind them.

Another weakly closes eyelids.

Blade edge catches restrained cool highlight.

Enemy does NOT move weapon.

============================================================
0:11.2–0:13.2 — CAMERA ROTATES AROUND STATIONARY SWORD
============================================================

35–50mm.

Perform a controlled approximately 60–80 degree camera orbit around the sword while Enforcer holds it still.

Strong parallax moves across:

fleshy faces,
dark metal edge,
binding material,
chains.

As angle changes, different faces come into focus.

Several independently perform tiny expressions.

No talking-mouth animation.

No screaming.

This should feel like impossible museum-object cinematography.

============================================================
0:13.2–0:15.2 — MULTI-FACE MOVEMENT MONEY SHOT
============================================================

90–120mm.

Frame approximately 4–6 faces simultaneously.

Hold composition for almost TWO FULL SECONDS.

This is the critical proof-of-life shot.

FACE 1:
eyes track left.

FACE 2:
brow contracts.

FACE 3:
mouth parts several millimeters.

FACE 4:
eyelids flutter once.

FACE 5:
remains nearly motionless except subtle breathing-like skin tension.

FACE 6:
black tear moves slowly.

NO synchronization.

NO yelling.

Camera itself makes only subtle 5–10 degree drift.

Give the audience TIME TO NOTICE THEM MOVING.

============================================================
0:15.2–0:17.2 — ENFORCER + SWORD RELATIONSHIP
============================================================

Rack focus slowly from faces in sword foreground to RED Enforcer book-head behind.

Sword remains in foreground occupying roughly half the frame.

Enemy's living book-face subtly reacts.

Eyes move toward sword.

Head tilts perhaps 4 degrees.

Then rack focus back to trapped faces.

One trapped face appears to weakly look toward its wielder.

No dialogue.

This creates eerie relationship between creature and weapon.

============================================================
0:17.2–0:20.0 — FINAL ICONIC TRAILER PORTRAIT
============================================================

24–35mm extremely low angle.

Enforcer finally lowers / rotates sword only slightly from presentation pose.

Camera pulls backward.

Reveal full RED/BROWN Enforcer standing in enormous Cursed Library corridor.

Sword projects into foreground with agony faces still readable.

Shield remains separately held in opposite hand.

True chest cavity open behind.

Library visible through it.

Drifting pages.

Deep atmospheric bokeh.

One heavy foot subtly adjusts.

THUD.

Sword faces remain alive.

Final focus pull:

enemy book-face →
nearest sword face.

Nearest trapped face slowly closes its eyes.

CUT.

NO MUSIC STING.

============================================================
EXPENSIVE TRANSITION LOCK
============================================================

Use:

crossguard occlusion,
chain-near-lens wipe,
blade-material wipe,
focus handoff,
macro-to-wide match motion,
controlled orbit,
foreground sword depth.

NO random hard-cut montage.

Do not move camera so quickly that details blur.

This pass is deliberately more controlled than the combat material.

The unsettling movement comes from the FACES.

============================================================
ABSOLUTE FAILURE CONDITIONS
============================================================

FAIL if hero appears.

FAIL if Blue enemy appears.

FAIL if hounds appear.

FAIL if sword keeps swinging during macros.

FAIL if faces remain frozen.

FAIL if faces all move simultaneously.

FAIL if mouths repeatedly open and close like talking.

FAIL if faces scream.

FAIL if faces become angry demons.

FAIL if faces become identical clones.

FAIL if sword loses practical steel structure.

FAIL if skin becomes plastic.

FAIL if enemy fights.

FAIL if enemy shield fuses with arm.

FAIL if enemy chest becomes solid.

FAIL if music appears.

FAIL if any dialogue / language appears.

FINAL INTENT:

Do not treat this like a weapon glamour shot.

Treat it like a horrible discovery.

The audience first thinks the Enforcer carries an elaborately decorated cursed sword.

Then the camera gets close.

One eye moves.

Another face tightens in pain.

A black tear falls.

THE FACES ARE STILL ALIVE.

red/brown-black materials,
true hollow torso,
cursed Agony Sword,
heavy construction.

rear foot anchors,
hips settle,
torso leans forward,
shoulder drives,
arm extends,
heavy sword follows.

width,
crossguard,
handle,
dark forged metal,
organic bindings,
embedded human-like faces,
chains,
surface depth.

deep desaturated celadon,

green-black shadows,

charcoal stone.

eyes flick to blade,

small backward recoil,
shoulders tense,

breath catches.

real time during drive →

very brief 0.15–0.25 sec emphasis immediately before contact →

NO dialogue.

Books jump.

Wood cracks.

bookshelf.

disbelief.

blocking,

depth,
performance,

parallax.

height,
build,
facial structure,

hair remnants,
hood / no hood,
posture,
clothing remnants,
book size,
body asymmetry,
chest-hole silhouette.

24mm large-format lens.

partial cabinet,

several readable Margin Wailers close to route.

population becomes denser.

the living BOOK-HEAD when it lowers close enough.

brief,
fast,
speed-ramped,
shallow but visually shocking,
cutting across the leather face / cover,

eyes widen when second enemy appears,
quick side glance,
small backward recoil,
jaw tension,
rapid breath after impact,
brief stare at moving faces on enemy sword,
fear mixed with disbelief,
pain after getting hit,
small “what the fuck am I looking at?” facial response,

TIMECODED ACTION
==================================================

0:00–0:02.0 — START ALREADY IN MID-FIGHT

NO WALK-IN.

NO REVEAL SETUP.

START WITH VIOLENCE ALREADY HAPPENING.

24–28mm low moving camera.

Enemy A’s huge agony-face sword tears horizontally through foreground shelving toward hero.

Hero is already ducking and moving.

The blade passes inches above him.

Bookshelves explode.

Face-bound books are split apart.

Pages blast across frame.

One face-book cover tears open and its embedded face silently contorts.

Hero emerges from debris, sword in hand, chest hole clearly visible and completely see-through.

Camera movement continues without dead stop.

==================================================
0:02.0–0:04.0 — BLUE INTERCEPT / HERO REALIZES HE IS BOXED IN

Use the sword crossing frame as a physical wipe.

On the other side:

Enemy B rushes in from hero’s escape direction.

Hero turns and sees it.

Actual acting beat:
eyes widen,
head snaps slightly,
quick “oh shit” recognition.

Enemy B swings diagonally.

Hero does NOT hard-block.

He catches only the outer part of the strike with a glancing redirect and immediately pivots away.

Metal scrape throws sparks.

Impact still shoves his arms aside because of weapon mass.

==================================================
0:04.0–0:06.0 — TWO-ENEMY PRESSURE

40mm lateral tracking.

Enemy A advances shield-first from hero’s left.

Enemy B cuts off right side.

For approximately one second both enemies are clearly visible in same frame.

This is a major trailer shot.

Hero is physically trapped between them.

Enemy A thrusts shield forward.

Hero slips behind the shield edge.

Enemy B attacks simultaneously but misses narrowly because hero changes level.

Camera moves WITH hero through the gap.

No superhero acrobatics.
No flips.

==================================================
0:06.0–0:07.8 — AGONY-SWORD MACRO TRANSITION

As Enemy A recovers its sword, camera moves extremely close along the blade.

85–120mm macro.

Show:
wet cracked leather,
stitching,
embedded faces,
different expressions,
fine pores,
torn seams,
small chains,
wax,
bookbinding fibers.

One face squeezes eyes shut.
Another mouth slowly opens.
Another visibly trembles.

They are suffering because the weapon itself is being violently used.

The sword moves past lens and becomes a NATURAL WIPE into next shot.

0:07.8–0:10.2 — HERO GETS HIT HARD

New low three-quarter angle.

Enemy B swings.

Hero redirects first attack successfully.

Enemy A immediately follows with a SHIELD STRIKE from blind side.

Hero turns too late.

The large handheld bookshelf shield CLIPS HIM HARD across shoulder / upper body.

No gore.

Multiple shelves buckle.

Books fly outward.

Drawers break loose.

Hero lands among debris.

normal speed →
micro slow-down at shield contact →
snap immediately back to real-time as hero crashes.

50–70mm intimate moving shot.

Hero is on one knee / hand in wreckage.

Background shelves and drifting debris are clearly visible THROUGH HIS BODY.

He coughs / breathes hard NON-VOCALLY.

Expression:
shock,
pain,
disbelief,
adrenaline.

Enemy silhouettes approach through floating pages behind him.

Hero looks over shoulder.

Sees both.

Does not pose.

Immediately forces himself back to his feet.

Sword never disappeared.

18–21mm large-format lens.

Hero crosses close to lens while both knights converge behind him.

Enemy A’s shield occupies one side of frame.

Enemy B’s weapon crosses above.

Hero narrowly threads between:
falling books,
shield edge,
sword arc.

Strong scale.

No enemy gets pushed backward.

Hero survives purely through timing.

One blade strikes archive architecture directly behind him.

A shelf collapses diagonally.

Living books fall and writhe subtly in agony.

0:14.5–0:16.5 — OPTIONAL PRECISE HERO COUNTER

ONLY IF MOTION REMAINS CLEAN:

Enemy B overcommits and its elongated book-head lowers to hero’s level for a fraction of a second.

Hero sees opening.

Eyes lock.

Quick speed ramp.

Hero makes ONE extremely fast shallow cut across the leather FACE of the living book-head.

A precise surgical survival cut.

Blade slices across leather surface.

The book-face contracts in pain.

A few leather fibers / page fragments snap loose.

Enemy remains standing and dangerous.

Hero does NOT knock it backward.

Hero uses the opening only to escape past it.

Enemy A turns and swings the handheld shield toward hero.

Shield passes extremely close to lens.

Use the dark shield surface as a FULL-FRAME PHYSICAL OCCLUSION TRANSITION.

When it clears:

new wider angle.

The shield SLAMS into a shelf corner as hero slips away.

Wood explodes.

Several face-books are crushed.

One large book splits open.

Its human-like cover face stretches in silent agony as pages erupt.

0:18.2–0:20.0 — FINAL TWO-ENEMY TRAILER BUTTON

24mm wide low angle.

Hero emerges into a slightly wider destroyed section of archive.

Sword still in hand.

Chest cavity visibly true and see-through.

red/brown,
blue/steel.

weapon wipe,
shelf debris occlusion,
shield full-frame wipe,
macro-to-action handoff,
foreground paper wipes,
low floor tracking,
compressed close-ups,
wide two-enemy frames,
strong parallax,
controlled speed ramps.

prompt:
TITLE: HOLLOW HEART — WOMAN PARTIAL SPIRAL TRANSFORMATION

DURATION: 10 SECONDS
FORMAT: 9:16 VERTICAL
QUALITY: 8K IMAX / EXTREME LARGE-FORMAT MACRO PHOTOREALISM
STYLE: PRESTIGE PSYCHOLOGICAL DARK-FANTASY HORROR
MUSIC: NONE
AUDIO: DIEGETIC ONLY

ONLY THREE VISUAL REFERENCES:

REFERENCE 1:
EXACT WOMAN FACE MASTER.
This controls her identity above everything else.

REFERENCE 2:
EXACT WOMAN FULL-BODY MASTER.
This controls hair, clothing, age, proportions and Hollow Heart continuity.

REFERENCE 3:
EXACT HOLLOW HEART LAND / BIOME MASTER.
This controls ONLY the background color palette and atmosphere.

DO NOT MIX FEATURES BETWEEN REFERENCES.

THIS SHOT CONTAINS ONLY THE WOMAN.

NO WARDEN.
NO HERO.
NO OTHER HOLLOW HEART.
NO ROOT-HANDS REQUIRED IN FRAME.
NO ADDITIONAL CHARACTER.

======================================================================
CORE VISUAL IDEA
======================================================================

THE WOMAN HAS JUST HAD MOST OF HER WILLPOWER / HOPE EXTRACTED.

She is still the EXACT SAME WOMAN.

Her resistance has nearly collapsed, but she still possesses a few final moments of frightened awareness.

One of her EXISTING EYES begins transforming.

The corruption begins INSIDE THAT REAL HUMAN EYE.

The eye becomes the center of a THREE-DIMENSIONAL VOLUMETRIC BLACK-SMOKE SPIRAL.

THE RESULT IS NOT A HOLE.

THE RESULT IS NOT A BLACK DISK.

THE RESULT IS NOT AN EMPTY CIRCULAR CAVITY.

THE RESULT IS NOT A PERFECT ROUND TUNNEL THROUGH HER HEAD.

Instead:

a living vortex of charcoal-black smoke,
soot,
fine particulate,
shadow filaments,
and partially deteriorating facial material

continuously ROTATES INWARD around the original eye.

The transformation spreads gradually across approximately HALF OF ONE SIDE OF HER FACE.

Some original facial anatomy remains intermittently visible beneath and between layers of moving smoke.

The effect must feel:

volumetric,
three-dimensional,
alive,
constantly rotating,
unstable,
smoky,
deep,
beautiful,
horrifying.

======================================================================
ABSOLUTE WOMAN IDENTITY LOCK
======================================================================

THE WOMAN REMAINS THE EXACT SAME PERSON THROUGHOUT ALL 10 SECONDS.

Preserve exactly:

— age
— facial bone structure
— forehead
— eyebrows
— original eyes
— nose
— lips
— jaw
— cheekbones
— gray hair
— hairline
— skin texture
— wrinkles
— complexion
— scars / dirt already present
— clothing if visible

NO actress replacement.

NO identity morph.

NO younger face.

NO different woman.

NO generic monster face.

Even after approximately half one side becomes corrupted, the unaffected side must remain unmistakably HER.

======================================================================
BIOME / BACKGROUND LOCK
======================================================================

Maintain the EXACT established Hollow Heart biome color world.

Background is heavily BOKEH-BLURRED.

It must feel physically photographed with an expensive long macro / portrait lens.

Behind her:

— deep restrained crimson-red atmospheric light
— charcoal-black land
— occasional dark burgundy tones
— soft silhouettes of impossible corkscrewed / twisted branches
— extremely fine airborne ash
— subtle particulate
— no detailed background competing with her face

NO normal trees.

Any branches appearing in bokeh are:

twisted,
spiraled,
contorted,
hooked,
looped,
unnatural.

NO THICK FOG.

NO WHITE FOG.

NO BLUE FOG.

NO GRAY WASH.

The background must remain soft, dark, crimson-black and cinematic.

======================================================================
CAMERA — CRITICAL
======================================================================

EXTREME 85–100mm MACRO PORTRAIT PHOTOGRAPHY.

Very shallow cinematic depth of field while keeping the important eye and evolving spiral sharply resolved.

THE CAMERA MUST NOT REMAIN STATIC.

Use a very slow controlled ORBIT around her face throughout the shot:

approximately 15–25 DEGREES TOTAL.

Begin slightly three-quarter profile.

Gradually orbit around toward a slightly more frontal three-quarter position.

This creates strong realistic parallax between:

— eyelashes
— nose
— cheek
— eyebrow
— hair strands
— smoke vortex
— distant crimson bokeh.

The smoke must exist in THREE-DIMENSIONAL SPACE.

Some smoke filaments pass slightly in front of her face.

Some curl along the facial surface.

Some spiral inward toward the eye.

Some trail backward behind the cheek/temple.

No flat composited texture.

No stationary camera.

No artificial zoom-only movement.

======================================================================
0:00–0:01.8 — LAST MOMENTS OF HUMAN PANIC
======================================================================

OPEN EXTREME CLOSE on the woman's SAME FACE.

Approximately three-quarter profile.

Camera already begins the extremely slow orbit.

Her face is exhausted from the extraction.

But for these first moments there is still fear.

Her eyes MOVE MUCH MORE ACTIVELY than the previous generation.

Natural frightened eye behavior:

first glance quickly toward screen-left.

Then immediately screen-right.

Then slightly upward toward something unseen.

Then back toward the direction from which the threat came.

These are rapid HUMAN eye movements.

Not robotic.

Not perfectly timed.

Her pupils make tiny panicked micro-saccades.

Lower eyelid trembles.

Wet tear film catches the crimson environmental reflection.

Her breathing:

quick,
shallow,
uneven.

Her mouth opens slightly.

One quiet frightened inhalation.

Her gray hair moves subtly in wind.

She looks as though she is desperately trying to understand what is happening to her.

======================================================================
0:01.8–0:03.0 — THE EYE MALFUNCTIONS
======================================================================

STAY MACRO.

Do NOT cut away.

Focus shifts precisely onto ONE EXISTING EYE.

The other eye remains visible but slightly outside the focal plane.

The affected iris suddenly performs ONE tiny impossible rotation.

The woman freezes.

Her expression says:

“What just happened?”

The iris stops.

Her eye rapidly looks sideways.

Then—

the iris rotates again.

Slightly farther.

Her pupil remains physically connected to her eye.

No hole yet.

No black circle.

The radial iris fibers begin bending into a subtle spiral pattern.

Her eyelid involuntarily twitches.

The camera continues its slow orbit.

======================================================================
0:03.0–0:04.3 — THE VORTEX STARTS INSIDE THE IRIS
======================================================================

The iris rotation becomes continuous.

Slow but unmistakable.

Individual iris fibers begin curling inward around the pupil.

The pupil becomes darker and visually deeper.

Not larger like a cartoon.

Deeper.

As though spatial depth is appearing inside the eye.

Extremely fine BLACK SOOT PARTICLES emerge from the tear duct and lash line.

These particles do NOT simply float away.

They immediately become captured by the rotation.

They spiral around the eye in tiny corkscrew trajectories.

A very thin charcoal smoke filament emerges from the outer corner.

It curves around the eye.

Then bends inward toward the rotating iris.

This is the FIRST visible volumetric smoke vortex.

======================================================================
0:04.3–0:05.6 — SMOKE BUILDS AROUND THE EYE
======================================================================

The corruption spreads from:

IRIS
→ EYELIDS
→ EYEBROW EDGE
→ TEMPLE
→ UPPER CHEEK.

BUT IT DOES NOT CREATE A ROUND HOLE.

Instead:

multiple layers of black volumetric smoke begin corkscrewing around the eye.

The smoke has depth.

Different strands move at different radii.

Some tight fast inner spirals.

Some slower outer curls.

Fine black particles orbit within the smoke.

Small fragments of darkened skin texture begin breaking apart into soot and joining the vortex.

Her actual eyelid remains intermittently visible through transparent smoke layers.

Her eyebrow hairs distort and pull slightly toward the rotation.

The woman reacts.

Her unaffected eye widens.

Her breathing becomes frightened again.

She tries to look toward the transforming eye even though she physically cannot.

Tiny forehead muscles tense.

======================================================================
0:05.6–0:07.0 — THE FACE BEGINS UNRAVELING
======================================================================

Continue the slow camera orbit.

THIS SHOULD LOOK FUCKING INCREDIBLE IN PARALLAX.

The smoke vortex becomes visibly three-dimensional.

Foreground smoke passes slightly across camera focus.

Mid-layer smoke curls over her cheek.

Deeper black spiral material rotates close to the eye.

The transformation now occupies:

the affected eye,
most of the eyelid,
part of eyebrow,
temple,
upper cheek.

The facial surface DOES NOT simply disappear.

Instead it appears to UNRAVEL.

Fine fragments of skin coloration,
soot,
shadow,
and vapor

are pulled into the spiral.

The outer boundary remains irregular and constantly moving.

NO CLEAN CIRCULAR EDGE.

NO PERFECT ROUND SHAPE.

NO SHARP BLACK APERTURE.

The boundary looks like a storm eating into reality.

The vortex produces continuous charcoal-black smoke ribbons that curl inward and leave trailing wisps behind.

======================================================================
0:07.0–0:08.5 — HALF-SIDE PARTIAL SPIRAL
======================================================================

Transformation expands farther across ONE SIDE ONLY.

Approximately 40–50% OF THAT SIDE OF HER FACE is now involved.

Affected region:

— original eye at vortex center
— eyebrow area
— temple
— significant upper cheek
— a small area approaching the side of forehead

DO NOT cross fully over the nose.

DO NOT consume the mouth.

DO NOT transform the opposite eye.

THE OTHER HALF OF HER FACE REMAINS COMPLETELY HUMAN AND RECOGNIZABLE.

The spiral side is NOT EMPTY.

It contains:

deep rotating smoke,
multiple corkscrewing vapor bands,
soot particles,
shadow filaments,
fragments of recognizable facial surface briefly appearing and disappearing through the smoke,
a deep dark rotational center where the original eye remains the origin.

The smoke continuously moves.

Some wisps peel outward before being pulled back into the vortex.

This must look like a BLACK SMOKE WHIRLPOOL occupying part of a human face.

Not a physical hole.

======================================================================
0:08.5–0:10.0 — FINAL LEGENDARY MACRO
======================================================================

Camera completes its subtle orbit.

Settle into an unforgettable three-quarter close portrait.

One side:

the exact woman's surviving human face.

Wet normal eye.

Tear on cheek.

Gray hair.

Real skin.

Her expression has changed.

The initial panic is almost gone.

She now looks:

drained,
distant,
docile,
emotionally absent.

The other side:

a continuously ROTATING VOLUMETRIC BLACK-SMOKE SPIRAL originating from her former eye.

The smoke vortex remains active.

Dark vapor curls inward.

Fine soot particles circle.

Tiny wisps leak outward into air.

Parts of deteriorated cheek / brow surface flicker subtly beneath the moving smoke.

The corrupted side feels three-dimensional and deep without ever becoming a clean physical hole.

One final tiny movement:

her remaining HUMAN eye slowly loses focus.

The smoke spiral continues rotating.

CUT TO BLACK.

rapid breathing.

--------------------------------------------------
LORE / PHYSICAL LOGIC
--------------------------------------------------

This creature was originally HUMAN.

It repeatedly failed, surrendered, died, reset, and lost progressively more of its identity, hope, and resistance.

Eventually the realm transformed and repurposed it into an enforcer.

It now suppresses remaining resistance in newly arrived Hollow Hearts.

Its anatomy must therefore retain subtle evidence of the original Hollow Heart condition.

It is what remains when a trapped person has surrendered so completely that the realm itself begins using the body.

That tragedy should exist underneath the horror.

THE CRESCENT HEAD — ABSOLUTE LOCK
--------------------------------------------------

PRESERVE THE LARGE CRESCENT HEAD FROM THE PRIMARY REFERENCE.

Do not turn it into two horns.

Do not make it a helmet.

The crescent IS the transformed head.

It should remain enormous and slightly disproportionate to the body so that the creature can be recognized instantly from silhouette alone.

The outer crescent material resembles:

ancient calcified biological tissue,
weathered pale bone,
eroded lunar stone,
old scar tissue,
subtle chalky mineral deposits.

Surface detail:

fine cracks,
small chips,
minute pores,
old stains,
uneven weathering,
areas of gray discoloration,
subtle dark particulate trapped in cracks.

The inside portion of the crescent has been overtaken by BLACK CORRUPTION.

The transition from pale crescent to black tissue is extremely irregular.

No perfect dividing line.

Darkness spreads into the pale structure through branching veins, marbling, islands, and small fractures.

--------------------------------------------------
MULTI-EYE CLUSTER
--------------------------------------------------

Within the corrupted inner region of the crescent are approximately FIVE TO SEVEN organic humanlike eyes.

These eyes are NOT evenly arranged.

No symmetry.

Different sizes.

Different orientations.

Different lid structures.

Subtle differences in iris color and age.

Some are wider.

Some half-lidded.

One may be partially obscured by corrupted tissue.

Each eye can independently observe a different part of the environment.

The creature should look capable of watching several things simultaneously.

Maximum wet anatomical realism:

tear film,
tiny capillaries,
real eyelid folds,
subtle reflection,
slight discoloration around sockets.

No glowing supernatural eyes.

Some may produce thin BLACK TEAR streaks that disappear into the dark crescent tissue.

--------------------------------------------------
THE ORIGINAL HOLLOW HEART CAVITY
--------------------------------------------------

KEEP THE CREATURE'S ORIGINAL HOLLOW HEART OPENING.

It remains located HIGH in the upper chest:

sternum / upper pectoral / clavicular region.

Never the stomach.
Never lower abdomen.

The cavity must remain a genuine deep three-dimensional void.

Absolute darkness exists inside.

The creature has NOT healed.

The emptiness remains.

However, its body has developed an extreme defensive transformation around the wound.

--------------------------------------------------
THE SPIKED RIB-CAGE DEFENSE — CRITICAL NEW FEATURE
--------------------------------------------------

Across the original Hollow Heart opening, approximately FIVE TO SEVEN thick BLACK CALCIFIED RIB STRUCTURES have grown from the sternum and surrounding ribcage.

These are NOT manufactured armor.

They are biological skeletal growths.

They resemble a hybrid of:

human ribs,
calcified cartilage,
burned bone,
blackened root structures,
and subtle elongated finger-bone anatomy.

The ribs cross OVER the cavity from several directions.

Some originate from the left side.

Some originate from the right.

At least one grows diagonally from the upper sternum.

The pattern is ASYMMETRICAL.

No neat cage.

No perfect spacing.

The rib structures have essentially built an organic prison over the original emptiness.

BUT THE VOID MUST STILL BE CLEARLY VISIBLE BETWEEN THEM.

Never completely cover the hole.

The audience should be able to look between the black ribs and see absolute darkness extending deep inside the torso.

--------------------------------------------------
OUTWARD SPIKES — DEFENSE MECHANISM
--------------------------------------------------

Several of the calcified ribs continue beyond the edge of the cavity.

Their ends grow OUTWARD from the chest and terminate in irregular defensive points.

Approximately THREE TO FOUR clearly recognizable outward-pointing spikes.

These spikes should vary naturally.

One slightly longer.

One broken or blunted.

One hooked subtly downward.

One curves diagonally outward from the sternum.

Do not create a symmetrical starburst.

Do not cover the entire torso with spikes.

These are localized specifically around the original Hollow Heart wound.

They should look as though the creature's body spent years desperately attempting to PROTECT THE EMPTY SPACE.

The anatomy communicates:

“Nothing can reach this place anymore.”

The spikes are intimidating but tragic.

They are not decorative fantasy armor.

They evolved from trauma.

Surface:

charcoal-black calcified bone,
small cracks,
old chipped tips,
rough mineral texture,
faint burgundy tissue where the spikes enter living flesh.

At the bases of several ribs, the surrounding flesh should appear permanently pulled and remodeled from centuries of growth.

--------------------------------------------------
CORRUPTION ORIGIN
--------------------------------------------------

Make the darkest black corruption especially concentrated around the Hollow Heart cage.

This is important.

The black transformation should appear to have begun at or around the empty chest and spread outward through the body.

From the rib cage, thin branching dark capillaries travel across:

clavicle,
shoulder,
upper arm,
neck,
upper ribs.

Farther away from the cavity the corruption becomes less concentrated.

This subtly establishes the same process that can later begin happening to the HERO after repeated deaths.

The corruption should resemble transformed biological tissue.

NOT paint.

NOT clothing.

NOT magical glowing markings.

Texture combination:

charcoal skin,
subtle bark-like fissures,
obsidian-like dry patches,
dark burgundy undertones,
black rootlike capillaries,
occasional areas where pale original skin still survives.

--------------------------------------------------
BODY ASYMMETRY
--------------------------------------------------

Preserve the low crouched silhouette of the primary reference.

One shoulder sits noticeably higher than the other.

The spine is subtly twisted.

One arm is marginally longer.

The creature looks comfortable remaining extremely low to the ground.

It should appear capable of:

walking upright briefly,
dropping onto all fours,
moving with its long arms,
freezing in an unnatural crouched position.

The body remains physically powerful.

Do not make it skeletal-thin.

It should feel like a deformed human body that has become incredibly resilient over centuries.

Muscle groups should remain believable underneath altered tissue.

--------------------------------------------------
PALM-MOUTH
--------------------------------------------------

ONE hand contains the extraction organ.

On the central palm is a narrow irregular biological seam.

When completely closed it almost resembles an old scar.

For this image, show it very slightly open so the design is understandable.

Inside the palm seam:

deep black oral cavity,
wet dark tissue,
extremely fine uneven keratin ridges / tiny toothlike structures,
subtle saliva moisture.

Keep it SMALL.

Quiet.

Surgical.

Wrong.

Not a giant screaming mouth.

No tongue extending outward.

No cartoon teeth.

No face in the hand.

This organ extracts the emotional resistance of other Hollow Hearts:

hope,
willpower,
defiance,
motivation,
positive emotional energy.

--------------------------------------------------
REMOVE THE CONVENTIONAL BRACER
--------------------------------------------------

REMOVE the obvious fantasy-metal forearm armor from the primary reference.

The creature should not look equipped like a warrior.

Replace it, if necessary, with only a subtle remnant:

one very old leather-like binding partially fused into tissue,

OR

three thin calcified bands,

OR

a deteriorated cord embedded into the forearm.

Minimal.

Almost archaeological.

FORMER HUMAN CLUES
--------------------------------------------------

Include only ONE extremely subtle remnant of the creature's former human identity.

Best option:

a simple ancient ring still trapped around one malformed finger.

Weathered.

Small.

Almost overlooked.

Do not add necklaces, clocks, charms, collections or unnecessary accessories.

The ring should create the disturbing implication that this body once belonged to an ordinary person.

POSE
--------------------------------------------------

Full-body three-quarter frontal creature study.

Neutral seamless medium-gray studio background.

No environment.

No fog hiding important anatomy.

The creature maintains its iconic extremely low asymmetrical crouch.

One elongated hand supports part of its weight against the floor.

The opposite hand is lifted slightly and rotated enough that the subtle palm-mouth can be seen.

The massive crescent head leans at an unnatural angle.

The multiple eyes are looking in subtly different directions.

The Hollow Heart cage must be clearly visible.

The black rib structures must have enough separation for the deep void behind them to remain readable.

At least three outward-facing rib spikes must create a strong silhouette around the upper chest.

Studio lighting should emphasize:

crescent texture,
wet eyes,
black/pale tissue transition,
deep chest cavity,
rib cage depth,
outward spikes,
musculature,
palm-mouth,
scarring.

Use realistic cinematic rim light and soft controlled key light.

Deep but readable shadows.

--------------------------------------------------
MATERIAL QUALITY
--------------------------------------------------

Maximum micro-detail:

individual pores,
fine wrinkles,
scar contractions,
tiny tissue cracks,
bone mineral texture,
subtle moisture,
nail ridges,
eye capillaries,
skin translucency,
surface dirt,
old healed abrasions,
realistic muscle tension,
calcified rib scratches,
chips on spike tips.

Nothing should appear smooth or digitally sculpted.

The image must feel like a professional creature-effects department built a full-scale practical creature and photographed it with an extremely high-resolution cinema camera.

--------------------------------------------------
EMOTIONAL READ
--------------------------------------------------

The creature is terrifying.

But beneath the terror there should be something deeply sad.

It does not look enraged.

It does not snarl.

It does not pose like a boss battle.

It feels:

empty,
ancient,
watchful,
ritualistic,
emotionally extinguished.

This is not merely a monster.

This is what happens when a Hollow Heart finally stops fighting.

folder: Voices in the Void: Hollow Heart（夹4076）
prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic full-body horror enemy concept isolated on a seamless charcoal-gray studio background with subtle contact shadow only. No scenery, no text, no watermark. It must look like a photographed feature-film creature maquette brought to life: extreme photorealism, no painterly effect, no stylization, ultra-detailed flesh, tendon, scars, cloth, bone, corrosion, and metal.

Design a grotesque asymmetrical enemy combining a giant living hand-creature with a crescent-moon-headed body. The silhouette must be immediately memorable, ceremonial, predatory, and unmistakably original.

The lower/front mass is dominated by ONE enormous living hand with an extremely broad palm and long spread fingers, forming much of the creature’s crawling anatomy. In the CENTER OF THE PALM is a main embedded face with warped human-like features, a malformed jaw, scarred flesh, and deeply recessed eye sockets filled with subtle BLACK SPIRALING SMOKE instead of normal eyes. The smoke physically curls outward from the sockets. Several knuckles may contain small partially buried faces, each different and subtle.

IMPORTANT: the giant hand is NOT a separate creature. Its wrist and forearm physically connect into a larger hunched torso/body, creating one continuous anatomy.

From the upper torso rises the creature’s MAIN HEAD: a large unmistakable CRESCENT-MOON SKULL. The entire head silhouette must clearly read as a crescent moon, not horns attached to a normal skull. Make it asymmetrical, cracked, eroded, ancient, and slightly jagged, formed from dirty ivory moon-bone with pale gray, fossil beige, blue-gray staining, darker weathered tips, old staple repairs, scar-like seams, and selective black corruption inside fractures. The crescent face should feel sorrowful, creepy, intelligent, and predatory rather than cartoonishly angry.

The body is lean, stretched, corpse-like, and asymmetrical, with sinewy shoulders, old scars, blackened tissue, root-like corruption, wrapped black cloth, cords, embedded rings, lockets, and a few identity relics. One side can be thinner and more elongated while the weapon-bearing side is heavier.

One specialized arm carries or drags an IMMENSE LONG GREATSWORD. The weapon must be terrifyingly huge, heavy, rusty, jagged, ancient, and cursed: elongated blackened steel, extreme orange-brown corrosion, deep pitting, chipped irregular edges, brutal asymmetry, torn metal layers, scarred surfaces, and a long weathered grip. It must feel legendary and oppressive, NOT like a cleaver and NOT like a normal sword.

Obsessive hand detail: swollen knuckles, stretched tendons, torn cuticles, blackened nails, scar tissue, leathery folds, grime, embedded rings, and realistic pores. Add restrained black volumetric smoke around the palm-face, crescent fractures, and corrupted body seams.

The final creature should feel like a moving shrine of grasping regret and lunar despair: grotesque, ceremonial, terrifying, highly detailed, and unforgettable.

the approved kneeling Hollow Heart who obsessively gathers dirt from the ground and tries to fill the impossible hollow opening in his upper chest.

low cold wind,
fingers scraping wet dirt,
mud compressing,
small stones clicking,
quiet breathing,
cloth dragging across soil,
distant tree creaking,
faint Hollow murmurs,
occasional wet footsteps from the hero,
subtle ambient rumble from the clearing.

photoreal skin,
photoreal mud,
photoreal dirt beneath fingernails,
individual hairs,
real fabric fibers,
realistic moisture,
cinematic lens behavior,
realistic depth of field,
subtle film grain,
premium practical-effects feeling.

NO videogame look.
NO game-engine aesthetic.
NO obvious CGI.
NO duplicated background people.
NO generic zombie movement.
NO exaggerated monster acting.

--------------------------------------------------
STORY IDEA
--------------------------------------------------

These Hollow Hearts have been trapped here so long that they have developed meaningless rituals around the emptiness inside themselves.

They are not trying to survive normally anymore.

They repeat strange actions because some part of them still believes those actions will restore whatever was lost.

The hero is witnessing what he could eventually become.

--------------------------------------------------
0:00–0:02.5 — THE SOUND BEFORE THE REVEAL
--------------------------------------------------

OPEN EXTREMELY LOW TO THE GROUND.

100mm macro lens.

Do NOT immediately reveal the entire person.

Extreme close-up:

a dirty trembling human hand slowly drags through wet black soil.

Fingers scrape through:
mud,
tiny pebbles,
dead roots,
small fragments of dried leaves.

Dirt wedges beneath cracked fingernails.

The fingers gather a pathetic handful.

We hear:

SCRAPE...

breathing...

SCRAPE...

Camera slowly tracks with the hand.

In extremely shallow focus behind it we see another dirty knee pressed into the ground.

This should initially feel almost incomprehensible.

CUT.

--------------------------------------------------
0:02.5–0:05 — REVEAL THE RITUAL
--------------------------------------------------

35mm low three-quarter shot.

Reveal the KNEELING HOLLOW HEART.

He is extremely thin, filthy, exhausted and psychologically broken.

Both knees buried in wet soil.

Back hunched.

Shoulders collapsed inward.

His large established Hollow Heart opening remains centered HIGH in the upper chest / sternum area.

He holds the handful of dirt against the opening and slowly pushes the dirt toward the empty space.

Much of it simply falls back through or spills down his clothing.

He watches it fall.

No dramatic reaction.

Just exhausted disappointment.

Then—

without hesitation—

his other hand begins searching the ground for more.

He has clearly repeated this hundreds or thousands of times.

This is NOT frantic horror acting.

This is ritualistic hopelessness.

--------------------------------------------------
0:05–0:07 — MACRO: THE FAILURE
--------------------------------------------------

85–100mm close detail.

Focus on his hands and upper chest.

He presses another handful of wet earth toward the hollow.

Tiny clumps crumble.

Small pebbles hit the ground below.

His fingertips are shaking.

A thin smear of mud remains on the rim and clothing around the opening.

He uses one finger to carefully push a remaining piece of dirt inward.

It falls.

His hand freezes.

We hear one tiny stone:

click.

He looks down.

CUT immediately.

Do not linger.

--------------------------------------------------
0:07–0:09.5 — HIS FACE
--------------------------------------------------

Extreme 85mm facial close-up.

Maximum realism.

His face should be:
weathered,
gaunt,
dirty,
sleep-deprived,
emotionally depleted.

Eyes red and watery but almost too tired to cry.

No screaming.

No snarling.

No zombie expression.

His mouth hangs slightly open while he breathes through exhaustion.

He looks down toward the dirt.

Then briefly upward as if, for half a second, he remembers that there may once have been another life.

That tiny thought disappears.

His gaze falls back to the ground.

This should be heartbreaking rather than purely horrific.

CUT.

--------------------------------------------------
0:09.5–0:11.5 — HERO DISCOVERS HIM
--------------------------------------------------

50mm over-the-shoulder composition from behind the HERO.

The kneeling Hollow remains several meters ahead.

Hero stops walking.

His body visibly tightens.

He watches the ritual.

The hero does NOT speak.

His expression must be superb:

confusion,
disgust,
fear,
pity,
realization.

His eyes move from the Hollow's hands...

to the upper-chest opening...

then unconsciously down toward his OWN Hollow Heart for only a fraction of a second.

IMPORTANT:
do not turn this into another prolonged hero chest inspection.

It is simply a subconscious realization:

“That could become me.”

Hero looks back at the kneeling man.

--------------------------------------------------

Side-profile medium close shot.

No fear.

No curiosity.

No hostility.

He looks straight through him.

SCRAPE.

SCRAPE.

The hero is irrelevant to him.

That is more disturbing than an attack.

CUT.

--------------------------------------------------

Camera follows a small pebble as it rolls away through wet soil.

Use a smooth low tracking transition across the ground.

a broken thread,
a rusted key,
a dead flower,
a tiny cracked charm.

Camera continues—

revealing a DIFFERENT pair of hands.

Older.

minute branch flex,
slow eye tracking,
wind passing through attached structures.

Moss fibers.

fine cracks,
pitted weathering,
ash-gray staining,
subtle old scratches,
tiny patches of grime.

they noticed something.

fear,
confusion,
fascination,
disbelief.

prompt:
HOLLOW HEART WEAPON — “THE LAST DEFENSE”

Hyper-realistic live-action psychological dark-fantasy weapon, neutral gray studio cyclorama, entire approximately 7-foot weapon visible, maximum realistic material fidelity.

Create a manifested greatsword where only the central cutting edge and internal structural spine are forged dark metal.

THE MAJORITY OF THE WEAPON’S VISIBLE BODY IS FORMED FROM HUNDREDS OF MINIATURE HUMAN FOREARMS AND HANDS GRIPPING ONE ANOTHER.

Approximately 200–300 tiny blackened human arms.

Each arm emerges from another cluster and terminates in a realistic five-finger hand.

The arms interlock in repeated chains:

HAND grips WRIST →
that FOREARM leads to another HAND →
that HAND grips another WRIST →
continuing throughout the weapon.

They create a dense braided anatomical structure around a razor-thin internal blade.

No obvious beginning or end.

Some chains loop around the metal spine.

Some cross over one another.

Some hands clasp palm-to-palm.

Some fingers hook into neighboring wrists.

Some form layered shields around missing sections.

The anatomy looks impossible but structurally deliberate.

From far away:
the interlocked arm mass resembles ancient twisted black metal.

From near:
the illusion collapses and hundreds of individual human fingers become visible.

COLOR:
almost all miniature limbs are matte charcoal-black corrupted flesh with subtle ink-wet grooves.

Occasional wrists reveal tiny patches of dead gray human skin underneath corruption.

Thin black tendon threads tie gaps together.

TRUE ERASURE:
parts of BOTH the metal spine and several arm-chains simply disappear, producing open-air gaps while the weapon somehow remains aligned.

CUTTING EDGE:
one continuous brutal dark-metal edge remains exposed beneath the living lattice.

The hands never replace the actual sharpened edge completely.

VOLUMETRIC SMOKE:
black smoke leaks continuously from deep inside the woven arm mass, emerging between fingers and wrists like breath from within the weapon.

No fire.
No glow.

POSE OF HANDS:
roughly 70% tightly closed inward in protective gestures.
20% partially releasing.
10% fully turned outward and reaching away from the weapon.

This creates a visual progression from DEFENSE to OFFENSE across the length of the blade.

NO faces.
NO eyes.
NO skulls.
NO conventional sword ornament.
NO giant singular hands.
NO tentacles.

FINAL TARGET:
the weapon should make the viewer initially question what material it is made from.

Only in close-up should they understand:

THE WEAPON IS LITERALLY BEING HELD TOGETHER BY HUNDREDS OF DEFENSIVE HUMAN GESTURES.

And the gestures are beginning to turn against the world.

prompt:
8K IMAX. PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION — no 3D-render look, no game-engine look, no game-cutscene aesthetic, no visible CGI aesthetic. Premium invisible VFX are allowed, but everything must feel physically photographed in an expensive live-action feature film.

20-SECOND CINEMATIC STORY SEQUENCE.

DIRECT CONTINUATION OF THE HOLLOW HEART CLEARING.

NO MUSIC.

DIEGETIC SOUND ONLY:
cold wind,
rapid frightened breathing,
wet footsteps,
mud compression,
cloth movement,
deep ancient tree creaks,
subtle distant Hollow murmurs,
water splashes,
subterranean rumbling,
roots dragging through earth.

THIS GENERATION IS ABOUT ONE SIMPLE STORY:

A newly arrived woman still has enough human will to RUN.

She tries to escape the clearing.

The realm notices.

Something beneath the ground hunts her down and prevents her from leaving.

The hero witnesses this and realizes the world itself may punish resistance.

--------------------------------------------------
CRITICAL GEOGRAPHY
--------------------------------------------------

The enormous Trauma Tree stands BEHIND the woman at the beginning.

The woman runs DIRECTLY AWAY FROM THE TRAUMA TREE.

This direction must remain visually obvious.

The tree should progressively become farther behind her as she runs.

Never make her run toward the tree.

Never make her circle around the tree.

Never make her stand calmly in front of the tree.

The hero is positioned farther ahead in the clearing, between the woman's escape direction and the camera.

She is effectively running from the tree toward and eventually PAST the hero.

--------------------------------------------------
CHARACTER PERFORMANCE
--------------------------------------------------

WOMAN:

She is genuinely terrified.

This is not theatrical screaming.

Her nervous system is overwhelmed.

Irregular breathing.
Wet eyes.
Jaw trembling.
Desperate scanning.
Occasional involuntary sob-like breaths.
She almost trips because she keeps looking behind herself.

She is running because she believes she can still get away.

She must move with urgency.

Do not make her jog casually.

Do not make her walk.

Do not make her stop unnecessarily.

HERO:

The hero is NOT emotionless.

His acting must be superb and subtle.

He begins confused and disturbed.

When he sees this woman running in genuine panic, his face immediately changes.

Concern.
Alarm.
Confusion.
Fear.

His eyes constantly search:
woman → tree → ground → woman.

His body reacts before his mind understands.

He instinctively wants to help.

No action-hero confidence.
No blank stoicism.
No exaggerated screaming.

--------------------------------------------------
BACKGROUND HOLLOW HEART LOCK
--------------------------------------------------

Maximum THREE recognizable Hollow Hearts in the entire sequence.

Every one must be radically different.

NO DUPLICATES.

ONE:
an older one-armed male, extremely thin, standing almost motionless with head bowed.

TWO:
a middle-aged kneeling Hollow obsessively gathering tiny amounts of dirt and pushing it toward the empty cavity in the upper chest.

THREE:
a distant Partial Spiral-Face Hollow slowly stumbling through fog, one side of the face still human while the opposite side softly dissolves into black spiral smoke.

Different faces.
Different body shapes.
Different ages.
Different clothing.
Different posture.
Different behavior.

They are NOT a community.

They do not socialize.

They barely react.

They have given up.

--------------------------------------------------
0:00–0:02 — IMMEDIATE PANIC / NO SLOW INTRO
--------------------------------------------------

DO NOT begin with a long hero walking shot.

OPEN WITH ACTION.

Very low 24mm wide-angle camera approximately 20 centimeters above the wet ground.

The WOMAN suddenly bursts into frame running directly toward camera.

The colossal tilted Trauma Tree dominates the deep background behind her.

Its enormous mouth glows with restrained deep crimson light and exhales low volumetric fog.

The woman is clearly RUNNING AWAY FROM IT.

Camera rapidly dollies backward in front of her.

Wet roots and puddles streak through foreground.

Her frightened breathing is loud.

She glances over her shoulder once.

The tree recedes behind her.

This opening must immediately feel urgent.

--------------------------------------------------
0:02–0:04.5 — THE DEAD DO NOT CARE
--------------------------------------------------

Continue tracking her.

She passes the kneeling dirt-filling Hollow several feet to one side.

SHE DOES NOT TOUCH THEM.

SHE DOES NOT PUSH THEM.

SHE DOES NOT STOP.

The kneeling Hollow does not even fully look up.

In deeper background, the one-armed Hollow stands motionless.

The contrast is horrifying:

one person desperately running for her life while everyone else behaves as if escape no longer exists.

The woman breathlessly mutters:

"No... no... no..."

Natural, barely controlled.

--------------------------------------------------
0:04.5–0:06 — THE WORLD LOCKS ONTO HER
--------------------------------------------------

FAST CINEMATIC INSERT.

Extreme macro of one organic eye embedded in a side root of the Trauma Tree.

Wet eyelid.
Tiny veins.
Bark fibers fused around it.
Hyper-realistic reflections.

Its pupil suddenly rotates toward the fleeing woman.

CUT to another branch.

Two DIFFERENT embedded eyes turn toward the same direction.

CUT to the massive main face.

The Trauma Tree remains ancient, sorrowful and grieving.

It does NOT attack.

Instead:

its enormous eyes slowly track the woman.

The entire colossal face subtly tilts several degrees sideways and forward.

The crimson fog inside the mouth suddenly pulls inward for one second as though the tree inhaled.

Deep wooden GROAN.

CUT AWAY IMMEDIATELY.

--------------------------------------------------
0:06–0:09 — SOMETHING CHASES HER UNDERGROUND
--------------------------------------------------

HIGHER WIDE TRACKING SHOT from behind and slightly above the woman.

She continues running.

Far behind her — approximately 25 to 30 feet away —

THE GROUND MOVES.

Do NOT show exposed tentacles yet.

A long ridge suddenly forms beneath the wet soil.

Mud bulges upward.

The ridge travels rapidly beneath the earth like a giant buried snake.

Then a SECOND underground ridge appears several feet beside it.

Then a THIRD.

They curve around rocks and roots intelligently.

Puddles ripple before they reach them.

Loose stones jump.

Mud splits and closes behind their movement.

THESE ARE SUBTERRANEAN ROOT-ARMS PURSUING HER.

They must visibly originate far behind and GAIN ON HER.

Do not teleport them beside her.

--------------------------------------------------
0:09–0:11 — SHE ALMOST BARRELS INTO THE HERO
--------------------------------------------------

Dynamic side-tracking shot.

The hero turns toward the sound.

The woman rushes toward him and nearly collides with him.

She loses her footing for half a second.

Hero instinctively catches ONE of her forearms so she doesn't fall.

NOT a hug.

NOT a conversation.

NOT a prolonged encounter.

They make eye contact for less than one second.

Her expression tells him everything.

Pure terror.

She immediately yanks herself free and continues trying to run past him.

Hero turns with her.

Then he hears the underground movement.

His eyes snap toward the approaching terrain.

--------------------------------------------------
0:11–0:13.5 — THE CHASE ACCELERATES
--------------------------------------------------

GROUND-LEVEL CAMERA.

One subterranean ridge races directly past camera.

The earth swells dramatically above it.

Another cuts across the first trail.

Three separate underground root paths converge toward the woman.

Use dynamic cinematic camera movement.

Mud sprays.

Shallow water ripples violently.

Roots flex upward.

The hero realizes these things are specifically following HER.

He begins moving toward her.

--------------------------------------------------
0:13.5–0:15 — FIRST STRIKE MISSES
--------------------------------------------------

The leading subterranean ridge reaches her.

THE GROUND RUPTURES.

A long BLACK ROOT-ARM violently lashes upward.

Its forearm is serpentine and extremely elongated, composed of twisted black bark fibers and tendon-like root material.

At its end is an anatomically disturbing HUMANLIKE HAND with long articulated fingers.

NOT a tentacle.

NOT a zombie hand.

NOT a giant monster claw.

The hand reaches for her ankle—

MISSES.

Its fingers rake violently through the mud beside her foot.

She screams once from shock and keeps moving.

The hand instantly bends and pursues her along the surface like a snake.

--------------------------------------------------
0:15–0:17 — SHE IS CAUGHT
--------------------------------------------------

A SECOND underground trail erupts beside her.

Another elongated root-hand coils tightly around her ankle.

HER FORWARD MOMENTUM STOPS.

She crashes onto one knee and one hand.

Mud splashes.

No injury.

She tries desperately to crawl forward.

A THIRD root-hand bursts up behind her and coils around her opposite wrist.

Hero runs toward her.

She reaches toward him with her free hand.

--------------------------------------------------
0:17–0:18.5 — HUMAN CONNECTION
--------------------------------------------------

TIGHT DYNAMIC SHOT.

Hero dives/lunges forward and manages to grab the woman's free hand.

For approximately ONE SECOND they are physically connected.

This is the emotional money shot.

Her fingers clamp around his.

Hero is terrified but trying to pull her toward him.

Woman looks directly into his eyes.

She believes he might save her.

Behind her, another black root-arm rises.

--------------------------------------------------
0:18.5–0:20 — THE REALM WINS
--------------------------------------------------

The fourth and final root-hand coils around the woman's waist from behind.

It suddenly PULLS.

Her hand begins slipping from the hero's grasp.

Hero tightens his grip.

Their fingers slide.

Then—

THEIR HANDS SEPARATE.

The woman is dragged approximately two meters backward across the wet ground.

Not into the tree yet.

She is simply pulled beyond his reach and immobilized.

Two root-hands pin her wrists low to the earth.

One holds her ankle.

One coils around her waist.

She is breathing violently but cannot move.

Hero remains on one knee several feet away, hand still extended toward her, genuinely horrified.

The woman stares back at him.

The colossal tilted tree is visible far behind through rolling fog.

Every visible embedded tree-eye is now aimed toward her.

The defeated Hollow Hearts barely react.

Then—

EVERY SOUND DROPS ALMOST TO SILENCE.

From somewhere offscreen:

CLACK.

A dry ceramic sound.

Pause.

CLACK.

Another mask-like impact.

The hero slowly turns his head toward the sound.

The woman also looks.

CUT TO BLACK.

DO NOT SHOW THE COLLECTOR.

END.

CRITICAL NEGATIVES:

— NO 3-second opening hero walk.
— Woman RUNS immediately.
— Woman always runs AWAY FROM the Trauma Tree.
— Woman never pushes or interacts with a background Hollow.
— No duplicated Hollow Heart NPCs.
— No crowd.
— No active village behavior.
— No generic zombies.
— Subterranean root trails stay UNDERGROUND until the attack.
— Do not depict the chasing roots as glossy ropes already lying on the surface.
— Root-arms have serpentine elongated forearms ending in articulate humanlike hands.
— Exactly four major root-hands maximum.
— First hand misses.
— Second catches ankle.
— Third catches wrist.
— Fourth catches waist.
— Hero briefly grabs woman's free hand.
— Hero ultimately loses his grip.
— Woman must be visibly immobilized at the END.
— Do not let her remain casually standing at the ending.
— Tree watches but does not physically attack.
— Hero has visible fear, concern and confusion.
— No Collector visible.
— End only on mysterious mask CLACK sound.
— No music.

Different posture.
Different behavior.

They are NOT a community.

They do not socialize.

They barely react.

They have given up.

0:00–0:02 — IMMEDIATE PANIC / NO SLOW INTRO
--------------------------------------------------

DO NOT begin with a long hero walking shot.

OPEN WITH ACTION.

Very low 24mm wide-angle camera approximately 20 centimeters above the wet ground.

The WOMAN suddenly bursts into frame running directly toward camera.

The colossal tilted Trauma Tree dominates the deep background behind her.

Its enormous mouth glows with restrained deep crimson light and exhales low volumetric fog.

The woman is clearly RUNNING AWAY FROM IT.

Camera rapidly dollies backward in front of her.

Wet roots and puddles streak through foreground.

Her frightened breathing is loud.

She glances over her shoulder once.

The tree recedes behind her.

This opening must immediately feel urgent.

--------------------------------------------------
0:02–0:04.5 — THE DEAD DO NOT CARE
--------------------------------------------------

Continue tracking her.

She passes the kneeling dirt-filling Hollow several feet to one side.

SHE DOES NOT TOUCH THEM.

SHE DOES NOT PUSH THEM.

SHE DOES NOT STOP.

The kneeling Hollow does not even fully look up.

In deeper background, the one-armed Hollow stands motionless.

The contrast is horrifying:

one person desperately running for her life while everyone else behaves as if escape no longer exists.

The woman breathlessly mutters:

"No... no... no..."

Natural, barely controlled.

--------------------------------------------------
0:04.5–0:06 — THE WORLD LOCKS ONTO HER
--------------------------------------------------

FAST CINEMATIC INSERT.

Extreme macro of one organic eye embedded in a side root of the Trauma Tree.

Wet eyelid.
Tiny veins.
Bark fibers fused around it.
Hyper-realistic reflections.

Its pupil suddenly rotates toward the fleeing woman.

CUT to another branch.

Two DIFFERENT embedded eyes turn toward the same direction.

CUT to the massive main face.

The Trauma Tree remains ancient, sorrowful and grieving.

It does NOT attack.

Instead:

its enormous eyes slowly track the woman.

The entire colossal face subtly tilts several degrees sideways and forward.

The crimson fog inside the mouth suddenly pulls inward for one second as though the tree inhaled.

Deep wooden GROAN.

CUT AWAY IMMEDIATELY.

--------------------------------------------------
0:06–0:09 — SOMETHING CHASES HER UNDERGROUND
--------------------------------------------------

HIGHER WIDE TRACKING SHOT from behind and slightly above the woman.

She continues running.

Far behind her — approximately 25 to 30 feet away —

THE GROUND MOVES.

Do NOT show exposed tentacles yet.

A long ridge suddenly forms beneath the wet soil.

Mud bulges upward.

The ridge travels rapidly beneath the earth like a giant buried snake.

Then a SECOND underground ridge appears several feet beside it.

Then a THIRD.

They curve around rocks and roots intelligently.

Puddles ripple before they reach them.

Loose stones jump.

Mud splits and closes behind their movement.

THESE ARE SUBTERRANEAN ROOT-ARMS PURSUING HER.

They must visibly originate far behind and GAIN ON HER.

Do not teleport them beside her.

--------------------------------------------------
0:09–0:11 — SHE ALMOST BARRELS INTO THE HERO
--------------------------------------------------

Dynamic side-tracking shot.

The hero turns toward the sound.

The woman rushes toward him and nearly collides with him.

She loses her footing for half a second.

Hero instinctively catches ONE of her forearms so she doesn't fall.

NOT a hug.

NOT a conversation.

NOT a prolonged encounter.

They make eye contact for less than one second.

Her expression tells him everything.

Pure terror.

She immediately yanks herself free and continues trying to run past him.

Hero turns with her.

Then he hears the underground movement.

His eyes snap toward the approaching terrain.

--------------------------------------------------
0:11–0:13.5 — THE CHASE ACCELERATES
--------------------------------------------------

GROUND-LEVEL CAMERA.

One subterranean ridge races directly past camera.

The earth swells dramatically above it.

Another cuts across the first trail.

Three separate underground root paths converge toward the woman.

Use dynamic cinematic camera movement.

Mud sprays.

Shallow water ripples violently.

Roots flex upward.

The hero realizes these things are specifically following HER.

He begins moving toward her.

--------------------------------------------------
0:13.5–0:15 — FIRST STRIKE MISSES
--------------------------------------------------

The leading subterranean ridge reaches her.

THE GROUND RUPTURES.

A long BLACK ROOT-ARM violently lashes upward.

At its end is an anatomically disturbing HUMANLIKE HAND with long articulated fingers.

NOT a tentacle.

NOT a zombie hand.

NOT a giant monster claw.

The hand reaches for her ankle—

MISSES.

Its fingers rake violently through the mud beside her foot.

She screams once from shock and keeps moving.

The hand instantly bends and pursues her along the surface like a snake.

--------------------------------------------------
0:15–0:17 — SHE IS CAUGHT
--------------------------------------------------

A SECOND underground trail erupts beside her.

Another elongated root-hand coils tightly around her ankle.

HER FORWARD MOMENTUM STOPS.

She crashes onto one knee and one hand.

Mud splashes.

No injury.

She tries desperately to crawl forward.

A THIRD root-hand bursts up behind her and coils around her opposite wrist.

Hero runs toward her.

She reaches toward him with her free hand.

--------------------------------------------------
0:17–0:18.5 — HUMAN CONNECTION
--------------------------------------------------

TIGHT DYNAMIC SHOT.

Hero dives/lunges forward and manages to grab the woman's free hand.

For approximately ONE SECOND they are physically connected.

This is the emotional money shot.

Her fingers clamp around his.

Hero is terrified but trying to pull her toward him.

Woman looks directly into his eyes.

She believes he might save her.

Behind her, another black root-arm rises.

--------------------------------------------------
0:18.5–0:20 — THE REALM WINS
--------------------------------------------------

The fourth and final root-hand coils around the woman's waist from behind.

It suddenly PULLS.

Her hand begins slipping from the hero's grasp.

Hero tightens his grip.

Their fingers slide.

Then—

THEIR HANDS SEPARATE.

The woman is dragged approximately two meters backward across the wet ground.

Not into the tree yet.

She is simply pulled beyond his reach and immobilized.

Two root-hands pin her wrists low to the earth.

One holds her ankle.

One coils around her waist.

She is breathing violently but cannot move.

Hero remains on one knee several feet away, hand still extended toward her, genuinely horrified.

The woman stares back at him.

The colossal tilted tree is visible far behind through rolling fog.

Every visible embedded tree-eye is now aimed toward her.

The defeated Hollow Hearts barely react.

Then—

EVERY SOUND DROPS ALMOST TO SILENCE.

From somewhere offscreen:

CLACK.

A dry ceramic sound.

Pause.

CLACK.

Another mask-like impact.

The hero slowly turns his head toward the sound.

The woman also looks.

CUT TO BLACK.

DO NOT SHOW THE COLLECTOR.

END.

— the colossal Hollow Heart tree
— the selected individual Hollow Heart inhabitants

The older woman has just realized she is trapped in this realm and is desperately attempting to escape. She is the ONLY person in this immediate area still displaying frantic resistance and survival energy.

He is NOT stoic.

His breathing is restrained but uneasy.
His eyes constantly study this impossible environment.
His brow tightens.
His mouth remains slightly parted.
He is frightened, confused and hyper-alert but desperately trying to understand where he is.

Behind him, out of focus, several defeated Hollow Hearts move very slowly through the landscape.

One distant one-armed Hollow Heart stands motionless with its head hanging.

Another kneeling Hollow Heart obsessively gathers tiny handfuls of dirt and presses them toward the hollow opening in its upper chest, repeating the meaningless action with complete emotional exhaustion.

--------------------------------------------------

HARD CUT TO A VERY LOW GROUND-LEVEL WIDE SHOT.

The colossal Hollow Heart tree towers in the deep background.

The WOMAN is already RUNNING AWAY FROM THE TREE.

THIS DIRECTION IS CRITICAL.

She does not run toward the tree.
She does not wander sideways.
She does not interact with another Hollow Heart.

She is fleeing directly AWAY from that enormous gateway as though something there terrified her.

Camera sits only inches above the wet black ground.

Foreground roots whip past frame as the camera dynamically tracks backward ahead of her.

The scale difference is enormous:
tiny terrified woman sprinting away while the gigantic sorrowful tree dominates the world behind her.

Her performance is raw and masterful:
uncontrolled breathing,
tears,
panic,
confusion,
legs nearly giving out,
looking over her shoulder while running,
almost tripping but catching herself.

She passes the kneeling Hollow Heart WITHOUT TOUCHING THEM.

The kneeling figure barely reacts.
